back: Finance from within the business: owners' savings, retained profit, sale of assets, working capital.
Finance from outside: loans, overdrafts, trade credit, leasing, HP, shares, debentures, grants, venture capital, crowdfunding.
Profit kept in the business after tax and owners' payments; no interest, no loss of control.
Overdraft: flexible, short-term, interest on amount used, can be recalled. Loan: fixed sum and repayments, longer term, often secured.
Leasing: use without ownership, low outlay. HP: deposit and instalments, owned after last payment, costs more than cash price.
Finance for risky, high-potential businesses in return for a share of ownership.
Purpose and period, amount, legal form, size and age, cost, control, risk and existing debt, security.
